subject: Can't make the option value.name work in reshape2::melt()

messages.author: ddc1fc70af730460
messages.subject: Can't make the option value.name work in reshape2::melt()
parts:
Dear list,

I am using reshape2 and the great melt() to reshape a matrix.
I would like to use the option value.name to give the value column of
the melted result a personalized name, but that does not work.

Here is a reproducible example:

require(reshape2)
b <- matrix(0, nrow=5, ncol=20)
colnames(b) <- 1:20
rownames(b) <- LETTERS[1:5]
names(melt(b, varnames=c('foo', 'bar'), value.name='baz'))

And this is my sessionInfo():

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Can't make the option value.name work in reshape2::melt()
parts:
Hi:

I have ggplot2 autoloaded on startup in this session, so reshape is in the search path. Loading reshape2, I get the following:

library(reshape2)
u <- reshape2:::melt.array(b, varnames=c('foo', 'bar'), value.name = 'baz')
> head(u, 3)
  foo bar baz
1   A   1   0
2   B   1   0
3   C   1   0

# This apparently uses the reshape package's version:
# (melt() gets the same result since b is an array)
> u <- melt.array(b, varnames=c('foo', 'bar'), value.name = 'baz')
> head(u, 3)
  foo bar value
1   A   1     0
2   B   1     0
3   C   1     0

I find this interesting, since reshape2 is higher in the search path:
> search()
 [1] ".GlobalEnv"        "package:reshape2"  "package:stats"   
 [4] "package:graphics"  "package:grDevices" "package:utils"   
 [7] "package:datasets"  "package:sos"       "package:brew"    
[10] "package:lattice"   "package:ggplot2"   "package:proto"   
[13] "package:grid"      "package:reshape"   "package:plyr"    
[16] "package:methods"   "Autoloads"         "package:base"

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.12.1 Patched (2010-12-18 r53869)
Platform: x86_64-pc-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252  
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C                         
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252   

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  grid      methods

[1] reshape2_1.1    sos_1.3-0       brew_1.0-4      lattice_0.19-17
[5] ggplot2_0.8.9   proto_0.3-8     reshape_0.8.3   plyr_1.4

[1] stringr_0.4  tools_2.12.1

# -----------------
I decided to try this in a fresh R session in a directory where I have no packages autoloaded, and got the following:

> library(reshape2)

> b <- matrix(0, nrow=5, ncol=20)
> colnames(b) <- 1:20
> rownames(b) <- LETTERS[1:5]
> names(melt(b, varnames=c('foo', 'bar'), value.name='baz'))

[1] "foo" "bar" "baz"

> search()
 [1] ".GlobalEnv"        "package:reshape2"  "package:stats"   
 [4] "package:graphics"  "package:grDevices" "package:utils"   
 [7] "package:datasets"  "package:methods"   "Autoloads"       
[10] "package:base"
#--------------------------

Evidently, having both reshape and reshape2 in the search path causes the problem. If ggplot2 is loaded, one can't detach reshape:

> detach(package:reshape)
Error: package ‘reshape’ is required by ‘ggplot2’ so will not be detached

so it appears that you'll have to specify the reshape2 version of melt.array() as shown above to get the desired behavior for the time being when ggplot2 is loaded.

HTH,
Dennis

use reshape2, but will also use namespaces properly so this type of
problem doesn't occur.
